svg.title: Consecutive mismatch events in the predictive-processing context blocks
svg.desc: Per context, the realised schedule of mismatch events, the distribution of intervals to the previous mismatch, and the percentage of mismatch events that immediately follow another mismatch, split by whether the preceding event was the same deviant type.
svg.text: Consecutive mismatch events across predictive-processing contexts
A mismatch that follows another mismatch is not preceded by the standard context it violates
Each context block uses one pre-generated schedule identical across sessions (standard oddball 15, sequence 15, duration 14, sensorimotor 16)
Realised mismatch schedule within each context block
Each tick is one mismatch event, positioned by time within the block
Interval to the previous mismatch event
Highlighted bars are intervals short enough to count as adjacent
Mismatch events preceded by another mismatch
The second event is not preceded by the standard context it violates
Preceded by the same deviant type
Preceded by a different deviant type
